services.desc: We offer a variety of room sizes and configurations. Maximum capacity for each room outlined is subject to individual event requirements. For larger events, the Medicine Tree Hall, Rotary, Windmill, Sandstone, Heritage and Veterans rooms can be combined via removable wall dividers for capacity up to 500 for banquet service. Full commercial kitchens are also available to rent, please contact for more information and
